svg.title: Fiber smoothness is a structured distribution
svg.desc: A rational divisor class can be supported on rational points or on a nonrational closed point.
svg.text: Fiber smoothness is a structured distribution
A rational divisor class can be supported on rational points or on a nonrational closed point.
The published ECCp-131 points have χ(xP)=+1 and χ(xQ)=−1. Their pullbacks are both 𝔽p-rational classes.
f⁻¹(P)={B₊,B₋}: two rational points; uP splits over 𝔽p.
One degree-two place: uQ is irreducible over 𝔽p.
Rationality of the class does not require rational support.
B = number of signed factor-base points
Fiber splitting gives correlated projected summands. It does not reveal their factor-base logarithms.
Census scope: F_B is closed under X↦−X and Y↦−Y, excludes branch/infinity points; S_B uses two distinct X-coordinates. See notes for counts.
